Summarized translation of an anti-Foreign
and anti-Chinese handbill, copies of which
were distributed by Chinese policemen in
Chapel and Siangwan on March 8, 1939.

New Order Movement in the Orient.
------------------

This movement is to save China, to
establish peace in the Orient
and to realize Utopianism !

It is known by everyone that Chiang Kai Shek,
following his assumption of power some ten years ago,
perpetrated numerous evils on the people and the country.
Now, he has brought calamity upon the people by causing
the present hostilities through his adoption of a
pro-Soviet and pro-Communist policy.

As the collapse of Chiang's regime will soon take
place, we must start the rehabilitation of the already
destructed China by establishing a new order in the
Orient. The new order movement is framed in accordance
with the new international situation and international
justice and is required by the people of the Orient.
The feature of this movement is the realization of
political, economical and cultural cooperation between
China, Japan and Manchukuo for the formation of an
anti-Comintern front by the three countries. Speaking
truthfully, the new order, once established, will ensure
stabilization in the Orient and also help the world.

Being of a similar language and of the same race,
China and Japan have everything in common and should
cooperate with one another in the struggle for a bright
future. The Oriental people have long been under the
economic oppression of the White people; therefore the
three countries will have to save themselves by
pages.zh:
1939年3月8日由中国警察在闸北和江湾分发的反外及反华传单的摘要译文。

东方新秩序运动。
---

此运动旨在拯救中国，建立东方和平
并实现乌托邦！

众所周知，蒋介石在约十年前掌权以来，
对人民和国家犯下了无数罪行。
如今，他通过采取亲苏和亲共政策，
引发当前的敌对行动，给人民带来了灾难。

由于蒋政权的崩溃即将发生，我们必须通过在东方建立新秩序，开始重建已被破坏的中国。新秩序运动是根据新的国际形势和国际正义制定的，也是东方人民所要求的。这一运动的特征是实现中国、日本和满洲国在政治、经济和文化上的合作，由这三国组成反共产国际阵线。老实说，新秩序一旦建立，将确保东方的稳定，也有助于世界。

中日两国语言相似，种族相同，有着一切共同点，应当相互合作，争取光明的未来。东方人民长期遭受白人的经济压迫；因此，这三个国家必须通过

pages.en:
(2)

cooperating with one another.

China has suffered considerably from the Red evil
and also from the economic invasion of the White People who
regard her as a semi-colony. The White people were
instrumental in starting China's civil wars which were
profitable only to the White people, it therefore follows
that the White people are only blood sucking germs and
will eventually strangle us.

The Chiang regime does not attempt to save the
people but instead it conspires with the U.S.S.R., the
communists, Great Britain and France in increasing the
sufferings of the people. China will be a lost country
if Chiang carries on in his present fooling. Therefore,
if China desires true emancipation she must carry out
the new order movement and get rid of the red evil and
oppression by the White people.

Japan, China and Manchukuo unite !
Enforce economic rapprochment and strengthen
the anti-Comintern front !

Shanghai City Government.
pages.zh:
(2)

相互合作来拯救自己。

中国深受红色邪恶之苦，也遭受视中国为半殖民地的白人的经济入侵。白人是引发中国内战的推手，而这些内战只让白人获利，因此白人只是吸血的病菌，最终会将我们扼杀。

蒋政权不试图拯救人民，反而与苏联、共产党、英国和法国勾结，加剧人民的苦难。如果蒋介石继续其目前的愚弄行径，中国将成为一个亡国。因此，如果中国渴望真正的解放，就必须实行新秩序运动，摆脱红色邪恶和白人的压迫。

日本、中国和满洲国联合起来！
推行经济亲善，加强反共产国际阵线！

上海市政府。

Date March 8, 19 39

Subject. Anti-Foreign, Anti-Communist and Anti-General Chiang Kai-shek
Propaganda.

Made by. D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by. **〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕**

With reference to the attached reports dated
March 5 and 6 from Hongkew Station on the subject of
anti-foreign, anti-communist and anti-General Chiang Kai-
shek handbills being distributed by Japanese military
men from military motor trucks in the district, enquiries
show that this distribution forms a part of the
propaganda in the so-called "East Asia New Order Movement"
week starting from March 3. It is learned that copies
of this handbill were prepared by the Japanese Military
Intelligence Bureau, 130 Dalny Road, in its printing
works at the same address, which was formerly occupied
by the World Bookstore Printing Works.

This handbill, apart from insisting on the
union of China, Japan and "Manchukuo" against the

Appendix

Translation of a handbill, copies of which were scattered
on North Soochow Road near North Szechuen Road from
Japanese military motor trucks on March 5, 1939

----

What is the East Asia New Order Movement ?

The East Asia New Order movement is a movement
for the reconstruction and resurrection of a new China by
the new bloc of three mutually dependent states, i.e.
Japan, China and "Manchukuo". With a view to assisting
in the progress of world affairs and for the stabilization
of order in East Asia, the following four points are given
to assist the promotion of political, economical and cultural
relations between Japan, China and "Manchukuo".

(1) Establishment of International Justice in the Orient

China is an independent nation but there are
treaties, settlements and extraterritorial rights
which have placed her in the category of a semi-colony.
The tyrannical capitalistic Powers of Europe and America,
which exploit the Chinese people, should be made to get
out. In this way, the Oriental races will arrive at
their own emancipation, the Orient will then be
independent and China will enjoy her true independence,
- therefore, we must endeavour to effect the rendition
of the Settlements which are used as bases for evils.
Extraterritoriality must be abolished, and Japan at once
ready to give up her extraterritorial rights as has
already been announced by her to the foreign and Chinese
nationals.

(2) Japan-China-"Manchukuo" Anti-Communist Pact - Success

The Communist Party, which is the enemy of the
whole world, and the regime of Chiang Kai-shek, which is
pro-communist and fraternises with the U.S.S.R., should
be thoroughly exterminated. The anti-communist front
of Japan-Germany-Italy is exceedingly strong.
pages.zh:
附录

1939年3月5日从日本军用卡车在苏州河北路近四川北路附近散发的传单译文

----

什么是东亚新秩序运动？

东亚新秩序运动是一个由三个相互依存的国家，即日本、中国和“满洲国”组成的新集团，为重建和复兴新中国而发起的运动。为了协助世界事务的进展和稳定东亚秩序，提出以下四点以协助促进日本、中国和“满洲国”之间的政治、经济和文化关系。

(1) 在东方建立国际正义

中国是一个独立国家，但条约、租界和治外法权使其处于半殖民地的地位。剥削中国人民的欧美暴虐资本主义列强应当被赶出去。这样，东方民族才能实现自身的解放，东方将获得独立，中国也将享受其真正的独立，——因此，我们必须努力促成作为罪恶基地的租界的归还。必须废除治外法权，日本已立即准备放弃其治外法权，正如已向外国人和中国人宣布的那样。

(2) 日本-中国-“满洲国”反共协定 - 成功

作为全世界敌人的共产党，以及亲共并与苏联称兄道弟的蒋介石政权，应当被彻底消灭。日本-德国-意大利的反共阵线极其强大。

pages.en:
- 2 -

(3) Creation of New Culture for the Orient
Create a new cultural policy based upon the
old and superior culture. Get rid of all mal-practices
at once and improve the livelihood of the people.
(4) Japan-China-"Manchukuo" Economic Rapproachment
This aims at mutual existence and prosperity
for Japan-China-"Manchukuo". The economic relations
between these countries will be strengthened.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

(3) 创造东方新文化
基于古老而优越的文化，制定新的文化政策。立即消除所有弊病，改善人民生计。
(4) 日本-中国-“满洲国”经济亲善
这旨在实现日本-中国-“满洲国”的共存与繁荣。这些国家之间的经济关系将得到加强。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS Date ____

MAR 9 1939

Anti-Foreign Leaflets
Distributed

New Society Appeals for
New Order in Asia

Anti-foreign and pro-Japanese pamphlets printed in different colours were dropped last night shortly before 8 o'clock in Bubbling Well Road near Burkill Road and also in Nanking Road near Yunnan Road heralding the "new order" to be established in east Asia and blaming the "white peoples" for the trouble in the Far East.

The headline of the pamphlet reads: "Stop white people's aggression" and "establish the new order in East Asia." The pamphlets were distributed by the "China Youth Anti-communist League," which is a new organization so far as the ordinary Shanghailander is concerned.

It also blames the "white peoples" for the complete control of China's economic life and also for the Far Eastern crisis. The "white peoples" intrigues must be eliminated so that Asia will be for the Asiatic peoples.

It then goes on to say that in order to establish the "new order" in east Asia, Japan, China and Manchoukuo must co-operate because they are "three-in-one." Only when the "new order" has been established can the people enjoy perpetual peace, it is stated.

（批：File 9/3 E 2/3）

1939年3月9日

分发排外传单

新社会呼吁亚洲新秩序

昨晚8点前不久，在靠近伯基路（Burkill Road）的静安寺路以及靠近云南路的南京路上，有人投下了用不同颜色印刷的排外及亲日小册子，宣扬将在东亚建立的“新秩序”，并将远东的麻烦归咎于“白人”。

传单的标题写着：“停止白人的侵略”和“建立东亚新秩序”。这些传单由“中国青年反共联盟”分发，对于普通上海市民而言，这是一个新成立的组织。

传单还指责“白人”完全控制了中国的经济生活，并应对远东危机负责。必须消除“白人”的阴谋诡计，从而使亚洲成为亚洲人的亚洲。

接着传单称，为了在东亚建立“新秩序”，日本、中国和满洲国必须合作，因为它们是“三位一体”。文中称，只有建立了“新秩序”，人民才能享受永久和平。

（批：档案 9/3 E 2/3）

继周一在大陆馆发表夸大其词的演讲之后，正在此访问的日本议员、东方会总裁中野正广先生，于周二晚上在中央日本小学礼堂发表了长达三小时的演讲，吸引了上海有史以来规模最大的日本听众之一，《上海每日新闻》昨日（周三）报道。 x 另见 D 9073

Nipponese Plan Week For Shanghai

Placards On Vehicles, Airplane Handbills Schemed

Shanghai Japanese and pro-Japanese Chinese
will participate in a mass movement in celebrating a "New

Japanese press reported today.

Airplanes will scatter hand-bills over

radio programs will be broadcast by stations XQHA and
XOJB. Lectures sponsored by the Japanese Young Men's
Association will be delivered in the Tariki Shimpo

and the Consulate-General on Saturday night , the
second of the week's celebration

vehicles, and will be posted in
prominent places on the streets,
which will be gaily festooned with

leading Japanese newspapers will

day, the Japanese press reported.

纪念“新秩序”的示威活动
（印：特别警察 / S. B. D. 编号 9069 / 1939年3月8日）

日本人策划上海宣传周

计划在车辆张贴标语、飞机散发传单

据日本媒体今日报道，上海日本人及亲日华人将于周五参加一场庆祝“新秩序周”的大规模运动，届时将利用广播节目、讲座、标语和传单来推动这一事业。

除外国辖区外，飞机将在上海上空散发传单，同时 XQHA 和 XOJB 电台将播出特别广播节目。由日本青年会主办的讲座将于周六晚（庆祝周的第二天）在大陆新闻礼堂举行，主讲人为日本海军、陆军及总领事馆的官员。

宣扬“新秩序”的标语将由公共汽车、汽车、人力车及其他车辆携带，并张贴在街道显眼处，街道上还将装饰旭日旗和五色旗标志。

Slogans Scattered And Banners Displayed All Over

Starting the observance of “new
order week” throughout Japan,
Manchoukuo and that part of China
under Japanese control, slogans
and banners were scattered yester-
day throughout East Asia from
Manchuli to Canton and from Han-

“Tairiku Shimpo” reported.
Broadcast in Japanese, Chinese,
Russian and Mongulian, radio ad-

Asia to rally under the banner of
the new order in East Asia.
Mammoth mass demonstrations,
military parades and naval
manoeuvres ushered in the week
of celebration. Rising Sun and
five-barred flags dotted the streets
of East Asiatic cities, while planes
scattered handbills and placards
bearing slogans, the paper stated.
Baron Kiichiro Hiranuma, Japan-
ese Prime Minister, will broadcast
an address on the new order on
an international hook-up from 6.30
to 7 o’clock Saturday evening.
All theatres in Hongkew will set
up special equipment to receive

week’s activities with lectures and
musical programmes, the daily said.

Five Chinese leaders were to

10.10 o’clock yesterday morning.
The addresses will be continued
at the same time to-day Monday,
Tuesday and Wednesday.
Leading residents of the Russian
community will speak at the same
time on Sunday morning, according
to the Japanese journal. Re-
presentatives of the leading cities
in Chekiang will hold round table
talks on the new order on Thurs-
day of next week, which will be
broadcast by the same stations.
Huge amplifiers will be erected
atop the New Shanghai Hotel on
Tsungming Road to transmit the
addresses as well as other pro-
grammes every morning during the
week, the Shanghai “Mainichi”
reported yesterday.

of the Legislative Yuan of the

Tahira Hamada, Chief of the Mili-
tary Press Section here, outlined

dence;

culture which is characteris-
tically and intrinsically
Oriental;
3.—Establishment of the white
and yellow race on an equal

日本大规模开启
“新秩序”周

中国及满洲国各地散布标语、悬挂横幅，
日本举行盛大庆祝活动；广播演说阐释动机

据《大陆新报》报道，随着日本、满洲国以及中国受日本控制地区开始纪念“新秩序周”，昨日从满洲里到广州，从汉口到南萨哈林，整个东亚地区到处都张贴了标语和横幅。

电台用日语、汉语、俄语和蒙古语进行广播，呼吁东亚人民在“东亚新秩序”的旗帜下团结起来。

大规模的群众示威、军事阅兵和海军演习拉开了庆祝周的序幕。该报称，东亚各城市的街道上点缀着旭日旗和五色旗，飞机四处散发印有标语的传单和告示牌。

日本首相平沼骐一郎男爵将于周六晚6:30至7:00通过国际联播网发表关于新秩序的广播讲话。

虹口所有剧院将安装专用设备以接收该讲话。该日报称，本地广播电台 XQHA 和 HOJB 将通过讲座和音乐节目重点报道本周的活动。

广播讲话

五名中国领导人定于昨日上午9:58至10:10发表广播讲话。本周一、周二和周三将在同一时间继续播出讲话。

据该日文报刊称，俄国社区的主要居民将于周日上午同一时间发表讲话。浙江省主要城市的代表将于下周周四就新秩序举行圆桌会谈，并由同样的电台进行广播。

据《上海每日新闻》昨日报道，巨大的扩音器将被安装在崇明路的新上海酒店屋顶，以便在本周每天早晨转播讲话以及其他节目。

维新政府立法院院长温宗尧先生和本地军事报道部部长滨田大佐（Tahira Hamada，音译）昨日在《大陆新报》上发表文章，概述了新秩序运动的目标。

重要目标

温先生指出了在东亚建立新秩序的三个最重要目标，如下：
1.—完全恢复中国的主权，摆脱使中国处于半殖民地状态的枷锁，从而使中国获得纯粹的独立；
2.—复兴具有典型和内在东方特征的道德与文化；
3.—确立白种人与黄种人的平等地位

Historical facts and circumstances leading to the "colonization of China" were given a broad survey by Mr. Wen in his article in the Japanese daily.
He stated that Russia opened the China invasion from the north, while Britain thrust into the heart of China from the south, followed by France, which reduced part of Far East Asia to a semi-colonial position. Mr. Wen gave details of historical incidents and treaties imposed upon China by these Powers in exploiting China.
In contrast with the Western Powers' "march upon the East," Japan's actions in China have always been carried out in pursuit of collaboration and mutual prosperity with China, Mr. Wen commented in his article. The grip of Western Powers on China should be removed in order to save her from being an "eternal servant to the West," Mr. Wen remarked.
Chinese moral principles, codes and culture, which are of the world's best, have been sadly declining, he continued, in blaming "returned students" from America and Europe for being the cause of the "pitiful plight to which Chinese culture and morality" have been reduced.

Equality Of Races

China has been subjected to "Anglicized mandarins and French influences," he went on. He paid a high tribute to Japan, who "has assimilated the essence of Western culture and civilization, which she has made instrumental in helping to develop those of her own." Mr. Wen urged the "renaissance of China" as a most needed object in establishing the new order.
As to equality of races, Mr. Wen asserted that racial discrimination is being observed against Oriental peoples in America and Western countries.
China, Japan, and Manchoukuo, have treated foreigners on an equal footing, permitting their free entrance and allowing them to stay and carry on business in their territories, while America and the West look upon Orientals as heathens, he said, and have imposed limitations on the entrance of Orientals, and the conduct of business within their frontiers. In some cases, the doors of these countries have been shut against Eastern people, he added, declaring that demands should be made to do away with such "inhuman barriers and the inequality imposed against us."
The three points mentioned represent a minimum of East Asiatic demands to the West and America, he stated, which should be speedily realized. Only after these aims have been accomplished could East Asia hope to complete the establishment of a "new order."
Mr. Wen called upon the peoples in China, Japan and Manchoukuo to rally under the "common cause," to band together, and to "march on to the last objective in completing the new order."

Slogan Pronounced

The slogan "A new order in East Asia" was first pronounced by Prince Fumimaro Konoye, former Japanese Prime Minister in his declaration of November 3, 1938. War Cabinet subsequently adopted it as the basis of its policy in the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere." This was later confirmed by the Imperial Conference.

623:7

温先生在该日文报纸的文章中，对导致“殖民化中国”的历史事实和背景进行了广泛综述。
他指出，俄国从北方开启了对中国的入侵，而英国则从南方深入中国腹地，随后是法国，这些国家使远东部分地区沦为半殖民地地位。温先生详细列举了这些列强在剥削中国过程中强加给中国的历史事件和条约。
温先生在文章中评论道，与西方列强的“东进”相比，日本在中国的行动始终是为了追求与中国的合作与共荣。温先生 remarked 说，必须消除西方列强对中国的控制，以使中国免于成为“西方的永恒仆役”。
他接着指出，堪称世界最佳的中國道德原则、规范和文化正在令人痛心地衰落，他将此归咎于从欧美归来的“留学生”，认为是他们导致了中国文化和道德陷入“可怜境地”。

种族平等

他继续说道，中国一直受制于“英式化的官僚和法国的影响”。他对日本给予了高度赞扬，称日本“吸收了西方文化和文明的精髓，并利用这些精髓来帮助发展其自身的文化和文明”。温先生敦促将“中国的复兴”作为建立新秩序中最迫切的目标。
关于种族平等，温先生断言，在美国和西方国家，针对东方民族的种族歧视依然存在。
他说，中国、日本和满洲国对待外国人一视同仁，允许他们自由入境，并允许他们在其领土内居住和经商；而美国和西方则将东方人视为异教徒，对东方人的入境及其在其边界内的商业活动施加限制。他补充说，在某些情况下，这些国家对东方人关闭了大门，并宣称应要求废除这种“不人道的壁垒以及强加给我们的不平等”。
他指出，上述三点代表了东亚对西方和美国要求的最低限度，应迅速实现。只有在这些目标达成之后，东亚才有希望完成“新秩序”的建立。
温先生呼吁中国、日本和满洲国的人民在“共同事业”下团结起来，携手并进，“向着完成新秩序的最后目标前进”。

口号的提出

“东亚新秩序”这一口号最初由日本前首相近卫文麿亲王在1938年11月3日的声明中提出。战时内阁随后将其作为“大东亚共荣圈”政策的基础予以采纳。此后，御前会议对此进行了确认。

Colonel Hamada expressed the

他 remark 说，国民党政府一定看到了三民主义被这一新术语所表达的高远志向所掩盖，这一点得到了国民党影响下最具好战性的反日报纸的证明。滨田上校回忆说，该报在一篇社论中对此进行了批评，并对创造这一新术语的日本人表示了敬意。
滨田上校继续说道，这一概念“包罗万象”，包括在各种不同含义上实现日本、满洲国和中国的共同体实体，承认满洲国的发展，以及消灭共产主义。他评论说，在建立新秩序的过程中，应给予东方思想、其经济和政治制度以及其文化运动新的推动力。

圣战

他说，号召纪念“新秩序周”就像“一把照亮通往共同目标皇家大道的火炬，或是一支引领迈向新秩序目标的进军号角”。
滨田上校表示希望，“新秩序周”能唤醒试图将亚洲作为其剥削对象的西方列强，并警告那些“听命于这些列强摆布”的国民党政府。
这位军事领袖宣称：“这就是目前的敌对行动被称为‘圣战’的原因所在，这一事实将在当前敌对行动结束后变得清晰明了。”

I

What is the East Asia New Order Movement?

The East Asia New Order Movement is a movement
for the reconstruction and resurrection of a new
China by the new bloc of three mutually dependent
states i.e. Japan, China and Manchoukuo. With
a view to assisting in the progress of world affairs
and for the stabilisation of order in East Asia, the
following four points are given to assist the promotion
of political, economical and cultural relations
between Japan, China and Manchoukuo.

(1) Establishment of International Justice in the Orient.

China is an independent nation but there
are treaties, settlements and extraterritorial
rights which have placed her in the category of
a semi-colony. The tyrannical capitalistic
Powers of Europe and America, which exploit the
Chinese people, should be made to get out. In
this way, the Oriental races will arrive at their
own emancipation, the Orient will then be inde-
pendant and China will enjoy her true independence,
- therefore, we must endeavour to effect the
rendition of the Settlements which are used as
bases for evils. Extraterritoriality must be
abolished, and Japan at once ready to give up
her extraterritorial rights as has already been
announced by her to the foreign and Chinese nationals.

(2) Japanese-Chinese-Manchoukuo Anti-Communist Pact - Success.

The Communist Party, which is the enemy of
the whole world, and the regime of Chiang Kai-shek,

“新秩序周”
庆祝活动启动

同盟通讯社
本地新闻与翻译服务
第1页

据《大陆新报》报道，昨天（星期五），在日本、满洲国以及中国受日本控制地区开始庆祝“新秩序周”之际，从满洲里到广州，从汉口到南萨哈林，整个东亚各地散布了标语和横幅。

电台用日语、汉语、俄语和蒙古语广播，呼吁东亚人民在新秩序的旗帜下团结起来。大规模的群众示威、军事阅兵和海军演习拉开了庆祝周的序幕。该报称，东亚各城市的街道上点缀着旭日旗和五色旗，飞机则散发了印有标语的传单和招贴画。

日本首相平沼骐一郎男爵将于周六晚6:30至7:00通过国际联播网发表关于新秩序的广播讲话。

虹口所有电影院将设置专用设备接收该讲话。据该日报称，本地广播电台 XQHA 和 HOJB 将通过讲座和音乐节目重点报道本周的活动。
（续）

March 3, 1939.

MAINICHI

FIVE CINEMAS IN HONGKEW TO RELAY BROADCAST OF
PREMIER HIRANUMA'S SPEECH

The East Asia New Order Movement
Week opens on March 3 and closes on March 9. This will
be a nation wide movement. In order to make the great
mass of Chinese understand this movement, which is
sponsored by Japan, Manchukuo and China, the Great Eastern
Broadcasting Station has compiled a grand programme for
a week of propaganda among Chinese. Apart from
the general programme during the seven days, between 6.30
and 7 p.m. on March 4, the Towa Theatre, the Willie's,
the Ritz, the Second Kabukiza Theatre and the Hongkew
Cinema will be provided with a radio receiver on the stage
so that the audience may listen to Premier Hiranuma's
speech. On the top of the New Shanghai Hotel a loud
speaker will be installed and every day between 9.58
and 10.10 a.m. will broadcast news, plays and speeches
on the new order movement.
The weekly programme in
Chinese is as follows:-
March 3:- Lecture on the history and the development
of the East Asia New Order by the Shanghai Branch of
the Grand People's Association.
March 4:- Mr. Wang Chang Chun, Senior Councillor
of the Shanghai City Government, will deliver a lecture.
March 5:- Mr. Zavineff, Chief Secretary of the
Russian National League, formerly a Captain of the
Russian Imperial Army, will deliver a lecture on the
present situation in Soviet Russia and the anti-communist
axis.
March 6:- A Chinese director of the Central China
Water Works and Electricity Company will give a lecture
on the necessity of Sino-Japanese economic co-operation.
March 7:-A professor of the Reformed Institution
will give a lecture on "A light from the East".
March 8:- Mr. Hu Shou Chang, Chairman of the
Shanghai Labourers Happiness and Benefit Association,
will give a lecture on "The White peril"
March 9:- A Friendly conference will be held by
representatives of principal cities of Chekiang Province
such as Hangchow, Soochow, Wusih, Chinkiang, Shanghai,
Nantung Chow and Kashing.
At 11.01 a.m. March 3, Miss Liao will lecture on
Chinese women's understanding of the new order in the
East Asia.
At 5.15 p.m. March 3, Mrs Shimizu, Chancellor
of the local Japanese Consulate-General, will lecture
on the movement to create a new order in the East Asia.
At 6.40 p.m. March 3, Major-General Takeuchi of
the Shanghai Special Service Organ will deliver a lecture
on "Shanghai as the centre of the new order in the Far
East".

1939年3月3日。

每日新闻

虹口五家电影院将转播平沼首相演讲

东亚新秩序运动
周于3月3日开始，至3月9日结束。这将是一场全国性的运动。为了让广大中国民众理解这一由日本、满洲国和中国发起的运动，大东亚广播电台为中国民众编制了一周的宣传盛大节目。除了七天的常规节目外，3月4日下午6:30至7:00，东和剧场、威利剧院（Willie's）、丽都大戏院（Ritz）、第二歌舞伎座和虹口大戏院将在舞台上配备收音机，以便观众收听平沼首相的演讲。在新上海大酒店顶部将安装扬声器，每天上午9:58至10:10将广播有关新秩序运动的新闻、戏剧和演讲。
中文每周节目安排如下：-
3月3日：- 由大民会上海分会讲授东亚新秩序的历史与发展。
3月4日：- 上海市政府高级顾问王昌春先生将发表演讲。
3月5日：- 俄国国民联盟秘书长、前沙俄陆军上尉 Zavineff 先生将就苏俄现状及反共产国际轴心发表演讲。
3月6日：- 华中水电公司的一位中国董事将就中日经济合作的必要性发表演讲。
3月7日：- 维新学院的一位教授将就“东方之光”发表演讲。
3月8日：- 上海劳工福利协会主席胡寿昌先生将就“白祸”发表演讲。
3月9日：- 将由浙江省主要城市（如杭州、苏州、无锡、镇江、上海、南通州和嘉兴）的代表举行友好会议。
3月3日上午11:01，廖小姐将就中国女性对东亚新秩序的理解发表演讲。
3月3日下午5:15，当地日本总领事馆秘书 Shimizu 夫人将就创建东亚新秩序的运动发表演讲。
3月3日下午6:40，上海特务机关竹内少将将就“上海作为远东新秩序的中心”发表演讲。

纪念“新秩序建设”的大规模示威活动

据日本媒体昨日（星期三）报道，上海日侨与华人将于明日（星期五）参与庆祝“新秩序周”的大规模运动，届时将利用广播节目、讲座、标语牌和传单来推动此项事业。

除外国租界区域外，飞机将在上海上空散发传单，同时XQHA和XOJB电台将播出特别广播节目。据报纸称，在该周庆祝活动的第二天，即星期六晚间，由日本青年会主办的讲座将在《大陆新报》礼堂举行，主讲人为日本海军、陆军军官及总领事馆官员。

日报指出，宣扬“新秩序”的标语牌将由公共汽车、私家车、人力车及其他车辆携带，并张贴在街道显眼处，街道上还将悬挂旭日旗和五色旗，装饰得五彩缤纷。

口号将印在戏院门票、一角钱舞会门票以及商店出售商品的包装纸上。据日本媒体报道，两家本地日文报纸将于星期五发行特刊。

With reference to the attached report and the
translation from the Tairiku Shimpo dated February
27, I have to state that the local Japanese residents
shortly after the Sino-Japanese incident in 1932
built a small shrine known as the "Shokonsha" inside
the site of the "Shanghai Shrine", Kiangwan Road, in
honour of those officers and men who were killed in
that incident. An annual memorial service is held
on March 3, at this Shrine, and is attended by prominent
officials and members of the Japanese community.

The memorial service for this year will also
take place on March 3, at 10.30 a.m. but on a more
elaborate scale, as the officers and men who fell
in the fighting around Shanghai in 1937 will also be
enshrined. Prominent Military and Naval Officers,
Consular officials and a large number of Japanese
residents are expected to attend the ceremony. During
the afternoon of March 3, the Japanese military units
will give exhibition of "Jujitsu", fencing and wrestling
in Hongkew Park.

Commencing on March 3, the Japanese Authorities
are to observe the "East Asia New Order Week" with a
view to giving publicity to the so-called "New Order
in East Asia".

pages.en:
February 27, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

NEW ORDER MOVEMENT OF CENTRAL AND NORTH CHINA AT
SHANGHAI AND NANKING

At 10.30 a.m. February 26, representatives of
the Army, Navy and Diplomatic authorities, together with a
number of persons representing the Japanese Residents
Corporation, the Japanese Youth Corps, the Broadcasting Bureau,
and the Japanese newspapers, held a meeting to make arrangements
for the observance of an Oriental New Order Movement Week and
passed the following resolutions :-

1) The days for the movement be fixed as from March 3 to March
9 inclusive.

2) Lecture and concert at the Tairiku Kaikan on March 4.-----
The lecture will be held on behalf of the Youth Corps and
the concert will be given by the Navy Band.

3) Publication of pamphlets and posters.

4) Radio Broadcasting :- Special broadcasts will be made by
representatives of various bodies.

5) Distribution of handbills :- Aeroplanes will be used for
this purpose.

6) Theatres to be used for propaganda purposes :- Propaganda
will be conducted during the intervals.
pages.zh:
1939年2月27日。

《大陆新报》

华中及华北在上海和南京的新秩序运动

2月26日上午10时30分，陆、海军及外交当局代表，连同日本居留民团、日本青年团、广播局及日本报纸的代表多人，召开会议安排“东方新秩序运动周”的庆祝活动，并通过以下决议：-

1) 运动日期定为3月3日至3月9日（含首尾两日）。

2) 3月4日在大陆会馆举行讲座和音乐会。-----
讲座由青年团主办，音乐会由海军乐队演奏。

3) 出版小册子和海报。

4) 无线电广播：- 由各团体代表进行特别广播。

5) 散发传单：- 为此目的将使用飞机。

6) 利用剧院进行宣传：- 将在幕间休息期间进行宣传。
